 Rayo Vallecano host Elche at the Campo de Fútbol de Vallecas in Madrid in a LaLiga fixture that carries real significance for both clubs, particularly the visitors, who remain deep in the relegation zone. 
 Benat San Jose's side come into this match in mixed form. A draw with Getafe in their most recent outing continued a run of inconsistency for Rayo, who have shown they can win games but have struggled to string results together across the season. 
 Elche arrive under Martin Anselmi having shown some signs of life in recent weeks. A win at Espanyol offered encouragement, though their form over the past month still raises questions about their ability to pick up points away from home. 
 The visitors sit 18th in LaLiga and need points urgently. A trip to Vallecas represents a difficult task, but Elche will be aware that results elsewhere could shift the picture quickly if they can find a way to take something from this game. 
 Rayo have their own motivations to secure three points and climb away from the lower reaches of the table. Home advantage at the compact Vallecas ground has historically made them a difficult side to beat, and San Jose will be looking to use that to his team's benefit.
